filament_notes:
Profiling:
• temp 230..270: 240° and 255° has the least stringing. Overhangs are terrible everywhere except 270, but 270 has the most stringing.
• max flowrate: looked good up to 30m²/s, but a single line changed its color a bit at 28.5. Then -10% is 25.6, let's use 25.
• pressure advance: 0 is the only good one, 0.1 is already bad
• flow ratio: 0 and -0.1 are both good, I chose in between — - .05, which from 0.95 resulted in 0.90. Afterwards a "perfectionist" test between 0 and 0.035 showed 0.035 as best result, so 0.9 + 0.035 = 0.935
• retraction: 0.1 and higher seems to be okay, set to 0.2mm
name: NIT ABS (black, bowden, 0.6nzl)
